notes: «قال أخبرنا ح» leaves Ibrahim's shaykh unnamed; the taḥwīl joins him to the names after it, so Isa and the rest form the shared tail
«أبو القاسم، نبي التوبة» is the Prophet's kunya and epithet: he ends the chain and is not a link
«- يعني ابن غزوان -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«قال مؤمل حدثنا عيسى» repeats the second route; no new link
